mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, c.code AS type, c.name AS typeName, c.code AS category, c.name AS categoryName, p.description, p.location_text AS location, p.area_code AS area, p.area_name AS areaName, p.address, COALESCE(p.province, pg.city) AS province, COALESCE(p.city, pg.city) AS city, p.image_url AS image, p.longitude, p.latitude, DATE_FORMAT(p.open_time, '%H:%i') AS openTime, DATE_FORMAT(p.close_time, '%H:%i') AS closeTime, p.phone, p.rating, p.rating AS score, p.hotness, p.visit_count AS visits, pg.id AS placeGroupId, pg.name AS placeGroupName, pg.short_name AS shortName, pg.district

WHERE p.status = 1
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.location_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pg.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pg.short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND c.code = #{type}
AND p.area_code = #{area}
AND p.scene = #{scene}
AND p.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId}
AND ( p.province = #{province} OR p.province LIKE CONCAT('%', #{province}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{province}, '%') OR p.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{province}, '%') OR p.location_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{province}, '%') OR pg.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{province}, '%') OR pg.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{province}, '%') OR pg.district LIKE CONCAT('%', #{province}, '%') )
AND ( p.city = #{city} OR p.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') OR p.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') OR p.location_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') OR pg.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') OR pg.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') OR pg.district LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') )
AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{shortName}, '%') OR p.location_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{shortName}, '%') OR pg.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{shortName}, '%') OR pg.short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{shortName}, '%') )
AND ( p.scene = 'city' OR p.place_group_id = 100 OR p.area_code = 'campus_summary' ) AND COALESCE(p.area_code, '') != 'route'
AND c.code IN ('scenic', 'natural', 'waterfront', 'theme_park')
AND c.code IN ('historic', 'religious', 'memorial', 'landmark')
AND c.code = 'museum'
AND c.code = 'university'
AND c.code IN ('landmark', 'commercial')
AND c.code IN ('natural', 'waterfront')
AND (c.code = #{tag} OR p.area_code = #{tag})
mapper.select: SELECT code AS value, name AS label, scene FROM poi_categories ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT , 0 AS distance FROM pois p JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN place_groups pg ON pg.id = p.place_group_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.place_group_id = 3 AND p.area_code = 'campus_summary' THEN 1 WHEN p.place_group_id = 4 AND p.area_code = 'campus_summary' THEN 2 WHEN p.place_group_id = 5 AND p.area_code = 'campus_summary' THEN 3 WHEN p.place_group_id = 6 AND p.area_code = 'campus_summary' THEN 4 ELSE 100 END ASC, p.hotness DESC, p.rating DESC, p.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pois p JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN place_groups pg ON pg.id = p.place_group_id

FROM pois p JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN place_groups pg ON pg.id = p.place_group_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 1
SELECT ai_summary FROM pois WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pois SET ai_summary = #{summary}, ai_summary_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
